home.widgets_meta: Put a live arrivals and departures board on your website — free, no sign-up, updates itself. Best for airports with regular scheduled flights.
home.widgets_intro: Pick an airport, copy the code, paste it into your page. The board shows live departures or arrivals, refreshes itself, and works on any site — hotels, transfer services, travel blogs. Works best for airports with regular scheduled flights; where no live data exists the widget says so honestly. Free of charge; the only requirement is keeping the small link under the widget.
home.widgets_note: Free for any website. Please keep the link under the widget — it is what keeps the widget free.
